name: Rogue Bloody Blade
body:
The bloody blade is a vessel of vengeance and terror.

They strike from the shadows using the surprise to terrify their foes.

Requirements
Alignment: A bloody blade must be non-good given the methods of the bloody blade and the motivations behind their actions.
Bloody Blade (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, whenever the bloody blade deals sneak attack damage with a melee weapon they can make a free Intimidate attempt to demoralize against the target and/or all allies within 30 feet of the target. The bloody blade can affect one creature per two levels with this use of Intimidate. To be affected, the target and the target’s allies must be able to see the bloody blade and the target to be affected.

This ability is treated as Dazzling Display for prerequisite purposes.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Frightening Mien (Ex)

At 2nd level, a bloody blade’s mere look can instill fear in a target. The bloody blade can make a demoralize attempt as a move action rather than a standard action.

This ability replaces the rogue talent gained at 2nd level.

Know the Fears (Ex)

Beginning with 3rd level, a bloody blade is adept at sussing out what will scare a creature. They gain a bonus on Intimidate checks equal to half their class level.

This ability replaces trap sense.

Use their Fear (Ex)

At 4th level, any creature that is subject to a fear effect or condition, such as shaken or panicked, is considered flat-footed for the purposes of the bloody blade applying sneak attack damage. They are not flat-footed for any other purpose unless they would be otherwise.

This ability replaces uncanny dodge.

Bloody Murder (Ex)

At 8th level, if a creature is reduced to 0 by an attack that would trigger the bloody blade ability, the target’s allies are frightened instead of shaken if the demoralize attempt is successful against them. A successful Will save (DC 10 + the bloody blade’s class level + their Charisma modifier) reduces the frightened condition to shaken.

This ability replaces improved uncanny dodge.

Blood on the Blade (Ex)

Beginning with 10th level, any creature that takes damage from the bloody blade’s sneak attack damage loses any bonuses to saves against fear and any immunity to fear against the bloody blade until the beginning of the bloody blade’s next turn.

This removal of immunity includes immunity to fear from other immunities like emotion or mind-affecting, but does not remove immunity due to the creature being mindless.

This ability replaces rogue talent gained at 10th level.
